purpose: Unify verified operational, safety, security, fleet, delivery, customer and financial intelligence into one explainable command surface.
rules: Verified critical safety or security signals remain the highest operational priority.
Unverified or demo signals may be displayed but cannot change live operational posture.
Missing live feeds produce UNAVAILABLE rather than invented numbers.
Conflicting verified signals require human review.
Commercial performance never overrides safety or security controls.
The control tower may recommend actions but cannot claim emergency dispatch, police notification, remote vehicle control or vehicle lockdown without authenticated integrations.
Every operator action must be attributable and auditable.
